mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) can cause nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity, which may compromise renal function and potentially alter carvedilol clearance; additionally, carvedilol may mask tachycardia symptoms that could indicate aminoglycoside toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) regularly during concurrent use; assess for signs of ototoxicity; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; ensure adequate hydration.
